purpose: Developer-facing Route Proof Trace. Previews the ordered setup cards a fresh scene should follow to reach the selected first proof, including definitions, participants, pawns, prefabs, required validation cards, proof enhancers, and the final Play Mode proof. This is documentation/debug evidence, not a preset or scene generator.
intentFocus: Platform Core + 6 capability route: pawn movement/control, animation/presentation, selection/action targeting, camera/framing, environment/procedural, networking
routeShape: Participant With Pawn: This intent is pawn-backed. The participant owns a PawnDefinition, the PawnDefinition owns the prefab, and participant input is the preferred control profile.
proofPriority: 1P Pawn Movement Proof: blockers are clear enough for a narrow Play Mode test.

proof.label: 1P Pawn Movement Proof
proof.guidance: One participant spawns one pawn, the selected InputProfile reaches a pawn input module, movement is visibly responsive, and the Game view follows the runtime shared camera focus.
proof.blockingReason: One participant spawns one pawn, the selected InputProfile reaches a pawn input module, movement is visibly responsive, and the Game view follows the runtime shared camera focus.
nativeSetup: Test in Play Mode on the active pawn-backed route, use press Play after the selected intent's Do Now setup is clear; move the pawn through the mapped input path and watch the Game view, then confirm one pawn spawns at the assigned spawn point, visibly moves through its selected 2D, 2.5D, or 3D lane, and the Game view follows the runtime GameplaySharedCameraFocus driven by that pawn.
Add in Inspector on selected GameObject, use Add Component -> NeonBlack/Gameplay/Traversal/Top Down Hop Feature Runtime, then confirm the component is added to the Inspector.
Create in Project on contract NativeSetup fallback, use create TopDownHopProfile, then confirm the referenced item exists in the chosen project folder.
Create in Project on contract NativeSetup fallback, use create FeatureModuleDefinition, then confirm the referenced item exists in the chosen project folder.
Assign in Inspector on Feature module setup, use assign runtime prefab with TopDownHopFeatureRuntime, then confirm the value is assigned in the authored definition.
Assign in Inspector on Feature module setup, use assign profile asset, then confirm the value is assigned in the authored definition.
Assign in Inspector on Feature module setup, use add module to PawnDefinition.featureModules, then confirm the value is assigned in the authored definition.
Bind in Inspector on Action binding, use bind Jump in InputProfile, then confirm the action role is connected in the authored action graph.
Add in Inspector on selected GameObject, use Add Component -> NeonBlack/Gameplay/3D/Pawn 3D Presentation Component, then confirm the component is added to the Inspector.
Inspect in Inspector on contract NativeSetup fallback, use Attach to a Pawn with ActorAnimationDriver., then confirm the setup step is captured and verified in the editor.
Inspect in Inspector on contract NativeSetup fallback, use Ensure Animator parameters match signal names., then confirm the setup step is captured and verified in the editor.
Add in Inspector on selected GameObject, use Add Component -> NeonBlack/Gameplay/Characters/2D/Pawn 2D Movement Component, then confirm the component is added to the Inspector.
Assign in Inspector on Feature module setup, use Add Rigidbody2D and Collider2D., then confirm the value is assigned in the authored definition.
Inspect in Inspector on contract NativeSetup fallback, use Keep on the same root as Motor2D., then confirm the setup step is captured and verified in the editor.

Inspect in Inspector on contract NativeSetup fallback, use Set Movement Style to SideViewGravity only for platformer-style gravity and ground checks., then confirm the setup step is captured and verified in the editor.
Create in Project on Top Down Hop Profile, use Create -> NeonBlack/Profiles/Top Down Hop Profile, then confirm the asset exists in the project.
Inspect in Inspector on contract NativeSetup fallback, use Implement interface in a movement component, then confirm the setup step is captured and verified in the editor.
Add in Inspector on selected GameObject, use Add Component -> NeonBlack/Gameplay/3D/Pawn 3D Movement Component, then confirm the component is added to the Inspector.
Inspect in Inspector on contract NativeSetup fallback, use Attach to a Pawn root with CharacterController., then confirm the setup step is captured and verified in the editor.
Assign in Inspector on Feature module setup, use Assign Ground Layer mask., then confirm the value is assigned in the authored definition.

orderedSteps.label: Tune Movement And Input Feel
orderedSteps.reason: This proof enhancer can make the first Play Mode check clearer, but it should not block the route proof.
orderedSteps.message: Before judging Play Mode, inspect the PawnMovementProfile, effective InputProfile, and installed FeatureModuleDefinition assets. Use PawnMovementProfile > Movement Style = TopDownNoGravity for free X/Y movement, add a top-down hop feature when Jump should lift the visual while staying map-plane grounded, or set Movement Style = SideViewGravity when Jump should drive Rigidbody2D vertical motion. The InputProfile maps Unity Input Actions into semantic roles; the pawn prefab still needs an input module such as Motor2DInputAdapter to dispatch those roles.

orderedSteps.label: Tune Camera Framing
orderedSteps.reason: This proof enhancer can make the first Play Mode check clearer, but it should not block the route proof.
orderedSteps.message: Before judging Play Mode, select Camera Root and CameraRigProfile and tune framing for the scene: physical Target Camera assignment, MainCamera tag/Brain on that physical camera, orthographic size, 2D Bounds Framing minimum visible area, Follow Damping (0 means no lag), Follow Offset, View Euler Angles for pitch/yaw/roll, and how much room the player needs around the pawn. In orthographic mode, CameraRigProfile > Orthographic Size controls zoom only until Camera Root > Enforce Minimum Visible Area 2D raises it to fit the authored min world size. Keep Use Profile Transform on for profile-driven framing, or turn it off when you want direct Cinemachine transform authoring. In Play Mode, Cinemachine follows a runtime GameplaySharedCameraFocus driven from participants; prove follow by moving the pawn, then verifying the Game view follows that shared focus.
